newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Ciba Speciality to offer U.S. ADRs.
newsitem.headline: Ciba Speciality to offer U.S. ADRs.

text.p: Ciba Speciality Chemicals Holding AG said it would offer American Depositary Recipts (ADRs) in the Unites States from August 11.
Ciba, which was spun off by Swiss pharma giant Novartis earlier this year, said Morgan Guaranty Trust Company of New York was the depositary bank for the ADRs.
Under the ADR program, investors in the U.S. will be able to buy American Depositary Shares (ADSs).
Two ADSs will equal one Ciba Speciality ordinary share with a nominal value of 10 Swiss francs and will be traded in the U.S. under the symbol CSYCY, the company said in a statement.
"Our establishment of an ADR program shows the importance that Ciba Speciality Chemicals places on the U.S. capital market," said chief financial officer Michael Jacobi.
